SELECT sys96_open_menu_log_id AS open_menu_log_id , sys01_company_nm AS company_nm , (CASE WHEN emp01_person_id IS NULL THEN '관리자' ELSE emp01_kor_nm || ' (' || f_get_emptrans(sys96_person_id, f_sysdate()::date, 'org_code_nm') || ')' END) AS person_info , (SELECT sys06_menu_no || ' ' || sys06_menu_nm FROM sys06_menu WHERE sys06_class_nm = sys96_class_nm LIMIT 1) AS menu_nm , sys96_class_nm AS class_name , TO_CHAR(sys96_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd HH24:MI:SS') AS date_str , sys96_second AS "second" , (sys26_ip_address || ' | ' || TO_CHAR(sys26_open_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd HH24:MI:SS') || ' | ' || f_cdnm('LoginModeCode', sys26_login_mode, 0, f_sysdate())) AS login_info FROM sys96_open_menu_log INNER JOIN sys01_company ON sys01_company_id = sys96_company_id LEFT OUTER JOIN emp01_person ON emp01_person_id = sys96_person_id LEFT OUTER JOIN sys26_login ON sys26_login_id = sys96_login_id WHERE 1=1
ORDER BY sys96_date, sys01_company_nm, emp01_kor_nm, sys96_class_nm LIMIT #{p.limit} OFFSET #{p.offset}

SELECT COUNT(sys96_open_menu_log.*) FROM sys96_open_menu_log INNER JOIN sys01_company ON sys01_company_id = sys96_company_id LEFT OUTER JOIN emp01_person ON emp01_person_id = sys96_person_id WHERE 1=1
